trails.description: Dominate modern web development with JavaScript, from the basics to advanced patterns.
Learn Python for data science, automation, web development and beyond.
Add strong typing to JavaScript and build scalable, maintainable applications.
Build dynamic user interfaces with the most popular front-end library.
Build fast, scalable server-side applications with JavaScript.

beginner.title: FizzBuzz
beginner.description: Print numbers 1 to 100. Multiples of 3 print 'Fizz', multiples of 5 print 'Buzz', multiples of both print 'FizzBuzz'.

beginner.title: Palindrome Checker
beginner.description: Write a function that returns true if a string is a palindrome.
beginner.hint: Reverse the string and compare to the original.

intermediate.title: Async Weather Simulator
intermediate.description: Simulate an async weather API call using Promises. Return a random temperature between -10 and 40°C after 1 second.

intermediate.title: Event Emitter
intermediate.description: Implement a simple EventEmitter class with on(), off() and emit() methods.
intermediate.hint: Store listeners in an object keyed by event name.

advanced.title: Observable Pattern
advanced.description: Implement a reactive Observable class that supports subscribe, unsubscribe and pipe operators.
advanced.hint: Look at how RxJS Observables work internally.

advanced.title: Memoize Function
advanced.description: Write a generic memoize() higher-order function that caches results based on arguments.
advanced.hint: Use a Map and JSON.stringify for the cache key.

beginner.title: Word Counter
beginner.description: Write a function that counts the frequency of each word in a text string.

beginner.title: Caesar Cipher
beginner.description: Implement a Caesar cipher encoder and decoder.
beginner.hint: Use ord() and chr() to shift characters.

intermediate.title: Task Manager CLI
intermediate.description: Create a command-line task manager that stores tasks in a JSON file with add, list, done and remove commands.

intermediate.title: CSV Analyzer
intermediate.description: Read a CSV file and compute average, min and max for each numeric column.
intermediate.hint: Use the csv module and avoid pandas for this exercise.

advanced.title: Mini ORM
advanced.description: Build a lightweight ORM that maps Python classes to SQLite tables, supporting save(), find() and delete().

advanced.title: Async Web Scraper
advanced.description: Write an async web scraper that fetches multiple URLs concurrently and returns a dict of URL → status code.

beginner.title: Typed Stack
beginner.description: Implement a generic Stack<T> class with push, pop, peek and isEmpty methods.

beginner.title: User Validator
beginner.description: Define an interface for a User and write a validation function that checks required fields.

intermediate.title: Mapped Type Builder
intermediate.description: Create a utility type Readonly<T> from scratch without using the built-in, then create Required<T>.

intermediate.title: Result Type
intermediate.description: Implement a Result<T, E> discriminated union and write helper functions ok() and err().

advanced.title: Type-Safe Event Bus
advanced.description: Build an EventBus where event names and payloads are fully type-safe using a generic map.

advanced.title: Deep Readonly
advanced.description: Write a recursive DeepReadonly<T> utility type.

beginner.title: Counter App
beginner.description: Build a counter with increment, decrement and reset buttons.

beginner.title: Todo List
beginner.description: Create a todo list where you can add, complete and remove items.
beginner.hint: Store tasks in an array state.

intermediate.title: useFetch Hook
intermediate.description: Write a custom useFetch(url) hook that returns { data, loading, error }.

intermediate.title: Theme Switcher
intermediate.description: Implement a dark/light theme switcher using Context API without any external library.
intermediate.hint: Use createContext and a ThemeProvider component.

advanced.title: Virtual List
advanced.description: Implement a virtualized list component that only renders visible rows for large datasets.
advanced.hint: Calculate visible window using scroll position and item height.

advanced.title: Form Builder
advanced.description: Create a generic form builder component driven by a JSON schema configuration.
advanced.hint: Use a reducer and dynamic component mapping.

beginner.title: File Walker
beginner.description: Write a script that recursively lists all files in a directory with their sizes.

beginner.title: Simple HTTP Server
beginner.description: Create an HTTP server without Express that responds to GET /hello with a JSON greeting.

intermediate.title: REST API with Express
intermediate.description: Build a CRUD REST API for a 'books' resource stored in memory.
intermediate.hint: Use Express router and an in-memory array.

intermediate.title: JWT Auth Middleware
intermediate.description: Implement a JWT-based authentication middleware for Express.
intermediate.hint: Use jsonwebtoken package and Authorization header.

advanced.title: Rate Limiter Middleware
advanced.description: Build an in-memory rate limiter middleware that limits requests per IP per minute.
advanced.hint: Use a Map with timestamps and sliding window algorithm.

advanced.title: WebSocket Chat
advanced.description: Create a real-time chat server using WebSockets and a broadcast mechanism.
advanced.hint: Use the 'ws' package and iterate over connected clients.
